objective: Improve native ContextBench Span-F1 through precise within-file acquisition without file-quality regression or excessive inference cost.
hypothesis: Optional class/function orientation beside ordinary source reads will be more discoverable than an advertised unused API, and may induce relevant follow-up acquisition.
selection_evidence: The complete12-case standalone-tool arm failed quality and used find_definitions only once. Function-only source capacity hints292/663 reads but only29/305 C++ reads. Clean containing-class orientation improves source-presentation reach without relaxing the parser, auto-reading, or widening final outputs.

construction_evidence.claim_ceiling: Source capacity only; serialized bytes are not tokenized live cost, helpful acquisition or quality.

source_policy.scope: Exact full-source snapshot associated with already executed ordinary base read. No global oracle source index or new file suggestions.
source_policy.eligibility: Only clean own-node class/function definitions overlapping but not contained in the read. Existing incomplete indices remain explicit. No parser changes or errorful-node relaxation.
source_policy.presentation: At most2 nearest functions plus1 nearest containing/intersecting class, or3 functions without a class. At most4096 metadata bytes per read; type/scope labels explicit. No added discovery tool.
source_policy.acquisition: Function suggested ordinary read at most100 lines; class header at most10 lines. Agent chooses whether to follow. Never auto-read, invent receipt, alter ordinary observation identity, accept metadata as final handle, or expand terminal spans.
source_policy.unsupported: Keep original read unmodified for unsupported/unusable parser status; whole-cohort denominator unchanged. Actual subprocess failure stops without replay.

prospective_native_contract.cohort: All12 previously exposed cases, original ascending order; fresh arm in distinct root. No retries, case replacements, or confirmation opening.
prospective_native_contract.label_barrier: All12 native arms terminal, identities checked and sealed before opening native scoring. No quality interpretation from partial cohort.
prospective_native_contract.control_posture: Archived native control and historical DSH are diagnostic, not fresh contemporaneous comparators.
prospective_native_contract.claim_ceiling: Exposed development only. Fresh matched comparators, untouched confirmation, uncertainty analysis and exact reviewer-approved claim remain required for superiority.

construction_boundary.authority: Standing owner private benchmark and GLM approval; D65 candidate research only.
construction_boundary.product_frontier: Pure source-presentation adapter and unchanged native acquisition/export.
construction_boundary.runnable_product_work: Separately frozen12-case inline orientation arm and once-only native scoring/audit.
construction_boundary.operational_lane: WSL source, pinned cached parser and evidence; fixed VPS GLM relay/credential; small isolated VPS scorer bundles only.

open_questions: Will inline hints induce relevant new ordinary reads rather than repeated headers or distracting context?
Can the clean-class increase in C++ presentation coverage yield precision-preserving native gains?
Will increased prompt context remain below the unchanged cost gate?
Would any exposed gain survive fresh matched controls and untouched confirmation?
